purpose: Frozen baseline before the 2026-07-04 groundedness/routing fix chain. Every downstream milestone in this fix is validated against match-or-beat vs this snapshot, per ADR-005/006 eval-first discipline.
trigger_incident: session dcc3693d-0aff-41ef-bd92-d943d008cb3e (Telegram) — E.E.V.A. fabricated a FIFA World Cup 2026 match result (Switzerland vs Algeria, then a fake Brazil 4-3 elimination) with zero search grounding on the second claim, and reinforced the fabrication when the user confirmed it conversationally.

flags_at_freeze.GROUNDEDNESS_GATE_ENABLED: does not exist yet — introduced in this fix chain

routing_eval_baseline.source: unmodified snapshot of tests/evaluation/routing_tuning_results.json as it existed at freeze time

relevance_gate_eval_baseline.note: No precision/recall/false-abstention eval exists yet for the relevance gate — this is a genuine gap being filled in Milestone 4. relevance_min_cosine=0.40 is explicitly documented in config/search.py as an untuned, conservative placeholder.

groundedness_eval_baseline.note: No groundedness-gate mechanism exists yet at freeze time (Milestone 2 introduces it) — there is nothing to baseline for this specific mechanism. The baseline for 'current behavior' on the 5 confirmed failure inputs is documented qualitatively in docs/decisions/007-generation-time-groundedness-gate.md once authored.
